violation_type.title: Written Operational Policies - Release of Children (26 TAC §747.501(1))
violation_type.short_title: Written Operational Policies - Release of Children
violation_type.typical_finding: The operation did not have operational policies available for review.

occurrences.finding: Written Operational Policies - Release of Children: The operational policy/parent handbook that the primary caregivers provide to the parents at the time of enrollment did not include all the required information. Information missing included promotion of outdoor physical activity, how to contact Licensing, health checks and more. These policies were broken down on separate documents not included in the parent handbook to be issued to parents.
